name: brand.location_drop
description: Removes one of the brand's saved locations, whatever its case; a label it does not have changes nothing. A post that names the location keeps it. Answers the brand's locations.
sql: update brandbase.brands b set locations = array(select l from unnest(b.locations) with ordinality t (l, n) where lower(l) <> lower(regexp_replace(btrim(:label::text), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) order by n) where b.id = :brand returning jsonb_build_object('locations', to_jsonb(b.locations)) as result
